title: String theory mathematics and matrix data analysis
summary: Inspired by matrix techniques in quantum field theory and string theory, we review Permutation Invariant Gaussian Matrix Models (PIGMM), which replace the continuous symmetries of traditional Random Matrix Theory, for $ N \times N$ matrices, with finite permutation symmetry, $S_N$. This symmetry-driven approach reduces highly multivariate $N^2$-variable matrix data analysis problems to a rich but tractable space of parameters.
